name: Eligibility Score vs Outcome
query:
select
	case
		when e.overall_score < 40 then '0-39'
		when e.overall_score < 55 then '40-54'
		when e.overall_score < 70 then '55-69'
		when e.overall_score < 85 then '70-84'
		else '85-100'
	end as score_band,
	count(*) as claims,
	round(avg(e.overall_score), 2) as avg_score,
	sum(case when cl.status in ('Approved', 'Partially Approved', 'Settled') then 1 else 0 end) as approved,
	sum(case when cl.status = 'Rejected' or cl.decision = 'Reject' then 1 else 0 end) as repudiated,
	round(sum(case when cl.status in ('Approved', 'Partially Approved', 'Settled') then 1 else 0 end) * 100.0 / nullif(count(*), 0), 2) as approval_rate
from `tabClaim Eligibility Evaluation` e
left join `tabInsurance Claim` cl on cl.name = e.insurance_claim
group by score_band
order by score_band
